description: İAFL Cosmos is a two-member student team from İstanbul Atatürk Fen Lisesi (Istanbul Atatürk Science High School), one of Türkiye's leading science high schools. Both of us code: one member drives the software, machine learning and data pipeline, while the other leads design, storytelling and presentation. We cover each other's gaps, so ideas move quickly from data to a working product and a clear story. We came to Space Apps to turn open NASA data into tools people can actually use.
